name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo Sepúlveda's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After a career in journalism covering local sports, he found himself drawn to the high-octane world of racing during a feature piece on a Santiago rally team. Intrigued by the blend of technical prowess and raw human emotion, he transitioned into a communications role with a small Chilean racing outfit, learning the ropes of media relations and sponsorship management.

Ricardo's approach to PR is rooted in storytelling. He believes in crafting narratives that resonate with both hardcore fans and casual observers, highlighting the passion and dedication that drive racers and teams. He's known for his ability to connect with people from all walks of life, from mechanics in the garage to CEOs in the boardroom. His visionary outlook allows him to anticipate trends and proactively shape the public image of his team.

What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of Chilean culture and his ability to leverage that to connect with the local fanbase. He's a master of crafting targeted campaigns that resonate with Chilean values and traditions, fostering a sense of community and loyalty around the team he represents.

physical.description: Ricardo has a warm, approachable face with a network of fine lines etched around his eyes from years of smiling.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of Neruda's poems and quotes from it during press conferences.
Insists on brewing his own maté in the office, creating a strong, earthy aroma.
Has a lucky racing scarf that he wears to every race, regardless of the weather.
